name: user_activity_count
description: Number of ratings the user gave before the cutoff

name: user_avg_rating
description: Mean rating given by the user

name: user_rating_std
description: Spread of the user's ratings, 0 for a single rating

name: user_positive_ratio
description: Share of the user's ratings that count as liked

name: user_days_since_last_interaction
description: Days from the user's last rating to the split cutoff

name: user_active_span_days
description: Days between first and last rating

name: user_preferred_genre
description: Genre with the largest share of the user's liked items

name: user_distinct_genres
description: Number of genres the user has liked at least once

name: user_genre_share_<genre>
description: Share of the user's liked items that carry the genre (rows sum to 1)
formula: sum(liked items with genre) / sum(liked genre tags)

name: item_popularity
description: Number of train ratings the item received

name: item_avg_rating
description: Mean rating of the item

name: item_bayes_rating
description: Mean rating pulled towards the global mean for items with few ratings
formula: (n * item_mean + m * global_mean) / (n + m), m = prior strength

name: item_positive_ratio
description: Share of the item's ratings that count as liked

name: item_release_year
description: Release year taken from the title
formula: regex (YYYY) in title, median if missing

name: item_age_years
description: Age of the item at the split cutoff

name: item_days_since_last_interaction
description: Days from the last rating of the item to the cutoff

name: item_genre_count
description: Number of genres on the item

name: genre_<genre>
description: 1 when the item carries the genre

name: rating_user_deviation
description: How far the rating is from the user's own mean

name: rating_item_deviation
description: How far the rating is from the item's mean

name: days_since_interaction
description: Age of the interaction at the cutoff

name: recency_weight
description: Exponential decay of the interaction age

name: user_genre_affinity
description: How well the item's genres match the user's liked genres (available at prediction time)
formula: mean over item genres of user_genre_share_<genre>
